scope: Separate worker process and real HTTP to an isolated loopback test server; temporary synthetic accounts and databases only.
lease_expiry: Controlled in disposable storage; no real-time expiry or RTO measurement.
limitations: Injected abrupt process exit after receipt arrival but before saving the local outcome; not a power-loss, remote transport, general exactly-once or physical acceptance test.
sanitization: Allowlisted counts and assertions only; no credentials, session tokens, identities, record IDs, URLs, database files or local paths exported.
